description: Protected AAC LTP (MPEG-4 ADTS profile 3) frames, mono: 24 frames that use long-term prediction but 13 and 14, the CRC of frame 9 wrong, so that the blocks that predict from its output are written and left out of the measurements until the pause of two frames.
findings: 1 ADTS frame fails the CRC check

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg does not check ADTS CRCs, and decodes every frame
skip.faad: faad2 reads ADTS profile 3 but its -i output names no LTP.
